question: Should OpenClaw accept selectable quick/full PR templates under `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE` while keeping the default fallback template?
rationale: The patch is small and uses GitHub's supported template path, but it changes the contributor PR-authoring contract and the linked issue is explicitly still awaiting product-direction acceptance.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Ask for current-head rendered proof for all three template paths, refresh the branch, then land if the screenshots and automation expectations still match.

options.title: Narrow the template contract first
options.body: Require wording or heading changes before merge if maintainers want the quick template to preserve more of the full PR context or contributor disclosure flow.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Reject selectable templates if maintainers prefer one canonical PR template and contributor guide flow over multiple authoring paths.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Ask for current-head rendered proof for all three template paths, refresh the branch, then land if the screenshots and automation expectations still match.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently authored the current PR template and PR context/proof policy surface that selectable templates must preserve.
